EYELESS_CROWN.title: Eyeless Crown
EYELESS_CROWN.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 Psychokinesis.
EYELESS_CROWN.flavor: The obsidian visor seals away mortal sight, sharpening the whispers of nearby spirits.
ALL_SEEING_CROWN.title: All-Seeing Crown
ALL_SEEING_CROWN.description: Replaces [gold]Eyeless Crown[/gold]. At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PsychokinesisPower}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold]. The first time you draw a [gold]Curse[/gold] each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
ALL_SEEING_CROWN.flavor: Through the cracked obsidian, a thousand spirits lend you their eyes.
SUNKEN_PRAYER_BEADS.title: Sunken Prayer Beads
SUNKEN_PRAYER_BEADS.description: At the start of Turn 1 in each combat, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SUNKEN_PRAYER_BEADS.flavor: Black beads washed ashore in the Underdocks, cold to the touch.
CRACKED_BELL.title: Cracked Bell
CRACKED_BELL.flavor: A mute bronze bell that chimes only when a Curse awakens.
OBSIDIAN_TUNING_FORK.title: Obsidian Tuning Fork
OBSIDIAN_TUNING_FORK.description: The first time you [gold]Exorcise[/gold] or [gold]Bless[/gold] each combat, gain [blue]{PsychokinesisPower}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
OBSIDIAN_TUNING_FORK.flavor: One strike aligns every wailing spirit into a single resonance.
INCENSE_CENSER.title: Incense Censer
INCENSE_CENSER.description: At the end of your turn, if you have at least 1 stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
INCENSE_CENSER.flavor: Its smoke does not banish grudges; it weaves them into armor.
SOULBOUND_MIRROR.title: Soulbound Mirror
SOULBOUND_MIRROR.description: Whenever you [gold]Exorcise[/gold] an enemy, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to it for each stack of [gold]Grudge[/gold] cleansed.
SOULBOUND_MIRROR.flavor: Bronze that reflects no living face, only the malice torn away.
GOLDEN_HAIRPIN.title: Golden Hairpin
GOLDEN_HAIRPIN.description: Whenever you spend [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold] to empower a card, regain [blue]{PsychokinesisPower}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
GOLDEN_HAIRPIN.flavor: A gilded pin that gathers stray psychic threads back into focus.
DREDGED_SHRINE.title: Dredged Shrine
DREDGED_SHRINE.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{PsychokinesisPower}[/blue] [gold]Psychokinesis[/gold].
DREDGED_SHRINE.flavor: A miniature shrine pulled from Underdocks silt, still humming with devotion.
